categories.description: Unlike the Any% route for Prey, the No OoB category takes all around the space station. In this category we utilize many different forms of speedtech such as clipping through walls with the goo gun, speed sliding off of ledges and creating infinite crafting materials.
categories.name: No OoB

games.description: Prey is one of the most amazing and overlooked immersion sims of all time. Just like most other immersion sims, it makes for a great speedrun with plenty of tech, interesting sections and fun moments.
games.name: Prey (2017)

categories.description: This category focuses on beating every exit in the game. ACE and Orb glitch is banned. We use Yoshi to do various glitches to finish certain stages faster by duping blocks over coins and manipulating values in the game. We spawn bosses out of yoshis mouth.  We also kill pipes.
categories.name: 96 Exits

games.description: Super Mario world is a huge classic with an incredible community. There are a lot of amazing glitches showed off in the runs that will mindblow the viewer.
games.name: Super Mario World

categories.description: In any% we race around the world, restoring the planet and defeat Dark Gaia. This run involves a lot of speed glitches, out-of-bounds skips and EXP manipulation. An incredibly fun run in a marathon setting.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: In All Medals we collect all 400 sun and moon medals. There's a lot of routing on the fly and quite luck dependant (Thanks Wentos). It's a cool category when it goes well, hilarious when things go wrong.
categories.name: All Medals

games.description: Unleashed Recompiled is a fan made recompilation of Sonic Unleashed and by far the best way to play the game. The whole objective of the game is to restore all 7 chaos emeralds whilst travelling around the world and defeat Dark Gaia. The last time this game was showcased at ESA was in 2015 and there has been a ton of discoveries that have been found since then.
games.name: Unleashed Recompiled

categories.description: Since this is still kinda in the oven, we don't have a locked in submission video or a super specific time (at least not before the submission deadline), but through our practice runs and routing we are very confident we can do this. Trust us bro™
categories.name: Any% Co-Op

games.description: A fresh new release, the newest entry in the Borderlands franchise. Game is a lot of fun, and even in the first month of routing a lot of speedtech has been discovered, allowing us to do some mad parallelization of runner routes in coop. A pretty entertaining watch, and a novel one as well
games.name: Borderlands 4

categories.description: Lara uses her newfound airwalk and nifty grenades to visit a diverse array of countries to hunt down the pieces of Excalibur, as well as a way to deal with relentless RNG, especially so in the motorbike segments.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: There are only 2 TR games left which I haven't showcased at ESA. Exhibit B: The first game after the initial reboot. No longer bound to the classics' tank controls, Legend introduced the free form movement that the series so desperately needed in a more modern setting. With it came a whole host of new glitches and strategies that would prevail for many games to come. This entry is probably best known for its iconic driving sequences, where Lara takes on foes while riding a motorcycle.
games.name: Tomb Raider: Legend

categories.description: Some of the most unique strategies in the series can only be marvelled at in this run. This includes jumping at walls from specific distances and angles to teleport to their top, clipping through doors and fences, and traversing an out of bounds area blindly with seemingly random yet precise inputs.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: There are only 2 TR games left which I haven't showcased at ESA. Exhibit A: The granddaddy of  them all, the OG Tomb Raider. The most barebones of all the games, item options are very limited, and the existing movement framework is not only heavily restricted, but also lacking a lot of the fluidity introduced in the successors. This clunkiness requires runners to be in a constant state of rhythm and following intricate movement lines. Making this game look fast is the ultimate badge of honour.
games.name: Tomb Raider

categories.description: Crash 3 - 108% full completion run where we obtain all 25 Crystals, 47 Gems, 5 Coloured gems, 31 Time trial relics and 5 boss power ups this also includes DLC level Future Tense. The game requires a ton of technical skill, most notably seen with the "glitched" movement tech hobslide and mach tornado
categories.name: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped 108%

games.description: Crash Bandicoot: N. Sane Trilogy is a 2017 remaster collection of Crash Bandicoot 1-3 that were released on Playstation 1. Full completion category of this game has never been showcased at ESA, there are similarities in the routing but have their own unique style compared to PS1 versions.
games.name: Crash Bandicoot: N. Sane Trilogy

categories.description: We obtain 8 gym badges, ruin team Flares plans and become regional champion. Biggest developement for the route recently has been skipping requirements for Lucky Egg in favor of other methods to beat the game fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Pokémon X/Y are 6th generation games for the series and 1st 3D Pokemon games on Nintendo 3DS handheld.
games.name: Pokémon X/Y

categories.description: I gave a higher estimate because of the incentive of choosing my color. If it is not accepted I could adjust the estimate down 10min. The main strat is to abuse the dungeon dice bonus to have a strong creature in from turn 1 already. RNG heavy dungeon layouts.
categories.name: Any% (random seed)

games.description:
The 1st video game of the famous collectible card game MTG is also known as Shandalar. 5 arch wizards need to be defeated to trigger the optional final boss.
Btw I'm slower than other runners bc I use my Win98 laptop with the 1.0 version.
games.name: Magic the Gathering (Shandalar)

categories.description:
Ideally only 3 missions are completed to beat the game: small UFO, Alien Base & Cydonia
There is no manip, but I must try to realize if I can get all I need from a mission (especially the base). So RNG can be tough sometimes.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Turn-based strategy where humanity defends against an alien invasion. Good that we can blow up walls to get to some parts quicker.
I'm playing this on a Win98 laptop booted into DOS.
games.name: X-COM: UFO Defense/ UFO: Enemy Unknown

categories.description:
Playing the full Atreides campaign (9 missions). The first 5 missions are pure strategy and very time critical.
From mission 6 onwards I'll be setting up the ghost glitch to turn a few of my units invisible to my enemies (terms apply). Then I can destroy their base without opposition.
categories.name: Atreides (MS-DOS)

games.description:
Famous for being one of the 1st RTS, Dune 2 features 3 campaigns with 9 missions each. The controls are a bit bothersome since you command only one unit at a time. Thankfully there are hotkeys.
I'm playing this on a Win98 laptop booted into DOS. .
games.name: Dune II: The Building of a Dynasty

categories.description: For this run we just play through all of the levels as quickly as possible, by performing all sorts of tricks we'll fly through the levels, skipping checkpoints and minibosses too. Cute music, adorable graphics, and quick, flashy, bouncy gameplay. Pb vid's 3rd ever run. Expected sub28 pre-ESA
categories.name: any% assisted

games.description: A platformer based around a specific gimmick: the star. Spawn and throw a star to kill enemies... or ride it for extra speed / platforming. Star is based on physics and will play into the physics of the player character. Get extra speed, more height, further distance by throwing the star. Frame perfect "horizontal stars" to gain extra speed on flat ground. Very hard and seemingly impressive tricks, most of them having safe backups! Swedish devs- maybe dev commentary?! Will get in touch with them
games.name: Gimmick! 2

categories.description: Unlcock everything with no restrictions, all tracks, all CC's -  showcasing not just all the glitches the game has to offer but the strange ways required to perform them with different kart/bike combinations.

Relay would be swapping who holds the controller after each race. 32 track skips takes you through every track in the game in an unrestricted manner to showcase game breaking tech. A new RTA viable method of a skip known as 'sign clip' has been implimented into this run by me this year also
categories.name: 32 Track Skips Relay

categories.description: Crazy new developments have happened in Mario Kart Wii in the last 6 months on a variety of tracks, this would showcase them with explinations as to what's going on using the game's built in ghost replay feature.  Vid gives example of the style. Estimate can be adjusted down/up if to help scheduling
categories.name: Glitch Showcase

categories.description: 32 track skips takes you through every track in the game in an unrestricted manner to showcase game breaking tech. A new RTA viable method of a skip known as 'sign clip' has been implimented into this run by me this year also which would be cool to showcase at a live event.
categories.name: 32 Track Skips

games.description: An iconic 2008 racer born into the most chaotic and recognisable karting franchise developed by Nintendo. The runs i've submitted showcase the faulty checkpoint system and amazing physics of the game engine to perform a multitude of track breaking skips in a variety of ways (wall clips; horizontal walls; one-frame OOB hop; ramp collision; wall riding).
games.name: Mario Kart Wii

categories.description: No glitches will be used. The entire Allied campaign on the hardest difficulty will be cleared as optimally as can be done normally.
categories.name: Hard Mode, Allied Campaign, Glitchless

games.description: Command & Conquer at its finest! The Allied Forces must repel the second Soviet invasion with as much strategy and surreal science as they can field. On the hardest difficulty, and without any glitches to help out, this challenge requires fast micro, well thought-out macro with little margin for error, and an intense need to adapt on the fly to any variations. See Red Alert 2 as well as it can be played
games.name: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2

categories.description:
Introducing gameplay while giving commentary about the different features, terminology and techniques that are relevant to understand the game. 
Followed by increasingly more difficulty being added as we progress. 
Ending on both players competing against each other. (If possible)
categories.name: Showcase%

games.description:
Sound Voltex is a rhythm game developed and published by Konami.
Game will be played on a custom (true to arcade size) controller featuring 6 buttons and two knobs.
Main appeal of the game is how you're forced to move your hands over the controller as you play, the music and the visual spectacle. 

Important!
The game servers undergoes maintenance 21.00 - 23.00 every day (During Swedish winter time) and is unplayable*.
games.name: Sound Voltex: Exceed Gear

categories.description: Clearing the expedition R4E1, with all optional objectives, as two players glitchless. Logs means that certain information about the map generation (notably, key locations) is known before dropping into the run, and is the main category ran in GTFO.
categories.name: Level: R4E1 Glitchless 100% Duo Logs

games.description:
Survival-horror co-op shooter, offering a unique blend of stealth and gunplay. Is known for being exceedingly difficult and is balanced around four players.
We are completing one of the most difficult missions in the game, R4E1. It shows a wide variety of game's mechanics, and splits up the players to work towards the objective a significant period of the time.
Playing as a duo adds to the viewer experience: it's significantly  easier to follow, and adds distinct roles to each player.
games.name: GTFO

categories.description: The randomizer comes with a ton of options to lock/unlock elements of the game requiring on the fly decision making on where to go with the items we have.
categories.name: Randomizer

games.description: Timespinner is a metroidvania based around a time stop mechanic. You navigate through the game (and time) to try to get revenge for your village, finding orbs (the weapons of the game) and other items to advance in the 2 versions of the world.
games.name: Timespinner

categories.description: This category asks you to collect 40 orbs, from a possible 64 within the game, to access the final boss. It features tricks, creative routing, and good game knowledge to beat the game without doing any major skips.
categories.name: 40 Orb

games.description: The second game in the Spyro the Dragon PS1 trilogy. This run is the no major skips any%, where you collect 40 orbs to enter and defeat the final boss. Orbs are collectibles achieved by completing tasks or minigames along the way.
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: All Missions Easy requires you to successfully complete each of the 16 missions that the game has to offer. The first three sections of the game are RNG-heavy, with a very difficult one-cycle later in the run. The inputs are simple but there is speedtech and lots of variance in this really fun run.
categories.name: All Missions Easy

games.description: Bob the Builder: Can We Fix It? is a game based on the CBeebies animated TV series from the early 2000s, about a builder named Bob, his colleague Wendy, and all of his anthropomorphic construction vehicles. The game itself is a series of puzzles and minigames that are more complex than first meets the eye.
games.name: Bob the Builder: Can We Fix It?

categories.description: The Aces Competition is a 3 on 3 round Robin tournament where racers pick and ban episodes from Sly 2-4 to race against. 1 episode per runner on each team. With fast paced action, a wide range of talent and the RNG of Sly anything can happen!!!
categories.name: The Aces Finals

games.description: The Sly Games after 1 are mission based steakth platformers where, similar to Oceans 11, we do jobs throught episodes before pulling of one big Heist at the end.
games.name: Sly 2/3/4

categories.description: The final episode. The final battle. Everything Sly 3 has given us comes back in a final test of our skills as the cooper gang. From 3rd person shooting, Fighting as "The Murray", Platforming and more! this episode gives constant action and speedrun tricks for every play style!
categories.name: Episode 6

games.description: Sly 3 is the final game in the PS2 Thieving platformer by sucker punch. Sly cooper wants to live up to the cooper name, and in order to do so, he must get access to his family vault, and prove himself a worthy successor of the name "Cooper'.
games.name: Sly 3:Honour Among Thieves

categories.description: Any% is the Bare-Bones run of the game. A quick start to finish beeline with money management kingdom hearts 1 style platform abuse and catchy tunes since we’ll be doing most Let’s dances. A great showcase of this hidden gem!
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: our fastest category showing all 5 Musical boss battles from the story of Oogie's
categories.name: Let's Dance

categories.description: All bosses is a highlight reel of the story of Oogie's that shows all bosses of the game, along with their chapters they're in. From fun Musical Fights, Giant spiders and even a train this category has it all!
categories.name: All Bosses

games.description: Nightmare before Christmas:Oogie's Revenge(Oogie's) is a Hack and slash rpg beat up made by the Devil May Cry team where Jack Skellington must save not only Halloween & Christmas, but all 7 holidays as well.
games.name: The Nightmare before Christmas oogies revenge

categories.description: In the Any% Triathlon category, the goal is to beat all three Spelunky games in a row. All three games follow the same formula: beat a bunch of randomly generated levels (spread across a few different worlds), then defeat the boss.
categories.name: Triathlon - Any%

games.description:
Apparently Spelunky has never been showcased at ESA before? I think it's time to change that! Spelunky is an indie platformer roguelike, infamous for its difficulty.

There are three games in the series: the freeware original from 2008 (Spelunky 'Classic'), the well-known HD remake from 2012 (Spelunky 'HD'), and the long-awaited sequel from 2020 (Spelunky 2). Every level is randomly generated, so you have to adapt on the fly to enemy spawns, item locations, and everything else!
games.name: Spelunky Series

categories.description: Like you'd expect from any%, my goal is simple: complete the game. I'll be playing as the Robot, who is one of the best characters in the game, and also the most consistent, due to its great stats and starting loadout.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Streets of Rogue is a top-down indie roguelite that's absolutely full of personality. The goal is simple: beat 15 randomly generated levels (which take place across 5 worlds, 3 in each). After that, you enter the Mayor's Village, to overthrow him in the name of the resistance. Personally, it reminds me a lot of GTA2, with the chaotic, sandbox-y "do what you want" nature of the game. With so many items, characters, weapons, etc... every run is different, so it's a blast to speedrun it.
games.name: Streets of Rogue

categories.description: Often called the best speedgame in UFO 50, Rail Heist is a train-heisting platformer that's kinda like a retro take on an immersive sim. Absolutely bursting with speedrun strats, you'll see zips, skips, movement tech, and more. A very fast paced run that's very memorable!
categories.name: Rail Heist (Gold)

categories.description: UFO 50's answer to the Cheetahmen: meet the Cyber Owls. You play as four different characters, each with their own distinct gameplay style. For example, one character, Guin, has NES Metal Gear-style stealth gameplay, but another, Octavio, has beat 'em up levels. A very unique and varied speedrun!
categories.name: Cyber Owls (Gold)

games.description:
UFO 50 is a collection of 50 different retro-style games, including a variety of different genres and game lengths. Each game in UFO 50 is its own fully-fledged game, each with their own unique speedruns and strategies.

Technically, I ran UFO 50 at last ESA, but don't be fooled: the runs I'm submitting aren't just different categories, they're totally different games than last time!
games.name: UFO 50

categories.description: Compared to the Any% Run of this Game, BTG showcases more areas of the levels and thus is a bit longer, while using different types of glitches/skips, also making the incentive more worthwhile, since more npc's will be heard talking. Besides that it's your typical speedrun fun with semi-new skips.
categories.name: Better than Glitchless (BTG)

games.description: As the 7th Game of the Tomb Raider Series everyone should know famous archeologist Lara Croft by now. While traveling around the world Lara tries to collect all pieces of the excalibur which she needs to uncover a secret of her Past.  Even though this Run swaps between refresh rates to allow things to work, it is all done ingame and doesnt really affect the Game capture. Since this game has 2 bike sequences no matter which category, its a good time to read out donations.
games.name: Tomb Raider: Legend

categories.description: As already teased, this Run is no joke though hilarious. Crazy glitches that through you across the map, passing through walls, invisible dragon and a funny cutscene. Though there a flickers happening im sure to make a early warning for the viewers and alot of backup savefiles just for safety.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Drakan is a Game about a Woman who lost her little brother to an evil entity and is now on a Quest of getting her Brother back. She gets a Dragon as her companion which funnily enough you can barely see in the speedrun, but trust me, he is there. The Run being only around 20minuts-ish while being a big game, might already tell you there are crazy glitches & skips happening. Due to new found routes & glitches it also gotten more consistent and is crashing less often than a few years prior.
games.name: Drakan: Order of the Flame

categories.description: The Categories in this game are a bit hard to understand, since the game is basicly just a hubworld with different portals to different type of challenges. Easily said: Go into every main level and finish it - with the double jump Ability, which wasn't planned for the base Game allowing cool skips.
categories.name: AC/No ACM - Double Jump (Without Trials)

games.description: Hot Lava is basicly "The Floor is Lava" just as a fun Videogame with some Banger songs. While Jumping from one stone to another might sound simple, there are a few tecs and skips that are still fun to learn and master. Besides that there is not much to say about the Game other than be fast and dont get burned to the crispiest of crisps.
games.name: Hot Lava

categories.description: This Run "7 Lasers" (old Any%) is mostly straight forward besides 2 long-range snipes and some neat little routing things. It's a treat to watch if you played through the Game.
categories.name: 7 Lasers

games.description: The Witness is a beautiful Puzzle Game set on an Island in the middle of nowhere. While it looks like you are only drawing lines, there a different "rules" you have to follow to figure out what the right solutions are.
games.name: The Witness

categories.description: In warpless the goal is to skip as many of the slower levels as we can, while still going through every world in the game. In a 2-players run we'll need to carefully manage our level, score and inventory routes on the fly, depending on what the roaming hammer bros will present us with.
categories.name: Any% Warpless

games.description:
In this classic stage play, Mario and Luigi blast through the Mushroom Kingdom at full speed, taking turns at shooting plants, duck jumping through tight spaces, clipping through a couple walls and maybe even dodging those pesky hammer bros if luck will allow it!
Featuring Tompa on commentary talking about subpixels.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 3

categories.description: The Any% category of The Minish Cap starts off very vanilla with the first glitch occuring at the 20 minute mark or so, and evolves into a lot of out-of-bound setups, subpixel setups, rng manipulation requiring frame-tight precision and a very hard frame perfect clip at about 1 hour into the run.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: The Firerod category uses all the power of the Firerod item to break the game in every conceivable way, be it sequence breaks, out of bound movement, parallel universes movement, and even editing the level during gameplay in often very funny ways.
categories.name: Firerod

games.description: Minish Cap is considered the last "retro" 2D Zelda game, ending an era of beautiful pixel art. The speedrun is very knowledge and tech intensive, overflowing with a lot of odd-looking glitches, out of bound movement of every kind, and RNG manipulations which require very solid execution.
games.name: Zelda : The Minish Cap

categories.description:
Complete the game without the use of the clip into the Ripto boss fight.
This category sees us collect 70% of the gems/dragonflies among the 8 worlds of the game to unlock and beat Ripto.
It's the category for those who ACTUALLY want to play this video game for longer than 1 minute :)
categories.name: Any% No Early Ripto

games.description:
Spyro: Enter the Dragonfly is the 4th console installment of the Spyro the Dragon franchise, released for PS2 and GameCube in 2002 by Universal Studio and developed by Check Six and Equinox.
Known for being severely rushed in development, EtD is filled with weird glitches and interactions, all of which lead to interesting runs.
Major glitches include swim in air, walk in air, as well as being able to clip through a solid amount of geometry making for unique routing potential in simple areas.
games.name: Spyro: Enter the Dragonfly

categories.description:
40 Orb No Double Jump is an extension of main category, 40 Orb, which sees the player getting 40 orbs and 14 talismans to beat Ripto.
The No Double Jump variant bans the use of Double Jump, an essential part of any Spyro 2 run, meaning routes and strats change to accommodate this limitation.
categories.name: 40 Orb No Double Jump

games.description:
Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! is the 2nd game in the PlayStation trilogy of Spyro games developed by Insomniac Games.
Known best for it's variety of glitches and exploits including double jumps, proxies, swim in air and many many out of bounds glitches, Spyro 2 offers massive variety for what you can and can't do in all of its speedruns.
No level is ever left as it was designed to be played and the level layouts themselves become playgrounds for an otherwise simple movement set.
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!

categories.description: Unreleased game, making assumptions based on Octopath 1 and 2. I put a video link from Octopath 1 so you can see commentary style. Will be learning whatever the fastest category is that obtains credits. Prior games have lent themselves very well to speedrunning
categories.name: Single Story or Any%

games.description: (Unreleased game, will come out December 4th) 2.5D JRPG prequel to Octopath Traveler. https://www.square-enix-games.com/en_US/games/octopath-traveler-0 I played a ton of both Octopath 1 and 2 and am very confidant in being able to put together a solid performance in 2 months
games.name: Octopath Traveler 0

categories.description: The classic, finish the level as fast as possible on easy difficulty.
categories.name: Easy Run

games.description: This is the N64 version of Quake, but played on PC, enabled by the native addon from the Quake Remaster in 2021. The N64 release did not have the start hub level, meaning that you keep your weapons between episodes, allowing for new and often even flashier routes than in the original Quake. Additionally, the maps themselves are altered a bit. Playing it on PC means that we can actually execute the routes with bunnyhopping and rocket jumps at the precision that we are used to from normal Quake.
games.name: Quake 64

categories.description:
Randomizer options will be set to make the seed realistic and beatable within 2-3 hours, however with crowd control it will make the experience all the more fun.
I also have a donkey kong costume to wear
categories.name: DK64 Randomizer Crowd Control

categories.description: Randomizer options will be set to make the seed realistic and beatable within 2-3 hours, I also have a donkey kong costume to wear
categories.name: DK64 Randomizer

games.description: Ooh banana, collect the bananas + abilities and beat KRool. Big fan classic for the memes behind the game.
games.name: Donkey Kong 64

categories.description: Beat the game. This category uses RNG MANIP and OOB. The most broken category for this game, The first 15 mins of the run and last 15 mins are intense RNG Manip. I will spend some time explaining tricks during this run.
categories.name: Any% US

games.description: Collect Spirits, Level up, Fight Challenging bosses and save the world from Mammon
games.name: Quest 64

categories.description: Using a legendary fishing controller I will free this pond of the evil fish!!!! Controller may vibrate uncomfortably during playthrough. I have to catch 4 Fish in total, sometimes they can also be tricky!
categories.name: Arcade Mode

games.description: Catching the Fish! BITE! This ones huge!!!
games.name: Sega Bass Fishing

categories.description: Warpless is beat all stages apart from extra bonuses stages,  Crowd Control lets you change Yoshi into a Train/Plane at any point, Force an air ground pound (beware of pits), Put the daze cloud effect any many more fun features. This was the most fun CC I've done and would love to do it for ESA.
categories.name: Any% Warpless (Crowd Control)

games.description: Travel through 6 worlds with the baby Mario companion to stop Baby Bowser! Game has really nice movement, a cool egg throwing mechanic and unique level designs. Also a banger soundtrack.
games.name: Super Mario World 2 - Yoshi's Island

categories.description:
1 Player per level 
DKC 1 - 40 Levels
DKC 2 - 41 Levels
DKC 3 - 42 Levels

Total 123 Players 

Can also reduce this to Just DKC 1 / 2 / 3.
categories.name: DKC Series 1-3 Any% No Major Glitches (Relay)

games.description: Classic sidescrolling 2D platform games , Banger Soundtracks and challenging level design.
games.name: Donkey Kong Country 1-3

categories.description: 6 Boards to Win, Win by bankrupting the CPUs (Fastest) or hitting a certain money goal on the board. Quite a challenging run with a lot of decision making and bit of RNG with dice rolls and RNG Cards.
categories.name: Mario Tour

games.description: Similar to monopoly but has shares and multiple other mechanics. Game is won by earning a certain amount of money or bankrupting an opponent.
games.name: Fortune Street (Boom Street)

categories.description:
Goal - Beat the final toad race. A lot of small optimizations to save time, some are risky. Some minigames you can lose out of your control. 
This game currently has some RNG Manip strat ideas being tested and will be cool to showcase something that might use software on the side.
categories.name: Mini-Game Island Any%

games.description: Classic Nintendo Board game but has single player modes as well.
games.name: Mario Party

categories.description:
Complete Hero Story all levels whilst chat causes chaos with Crowd Control. Shrinking/Enlarging the player, BUMPERS, Gravity, Speed,  Drunk Mode and more!
Crowd Control for SA2 seems way more fun for stream value than SA1. I used to speedrun this but do not have the vods anymore. PB is 45:30
categories.name: Hero Story (Crowd Control)

games.description: Classic 3D Sonic Game, Eggman is up to no good again but Shadow is also causing trouble. Has fantastic movement, unique level design.
games.name: Sonic Adventure 2

categories.description:
Linked video not my run - Have played game a lot casually, but never properly speedrun it before.
NMG does not permit arbitrary code execution/code injection.
categories.name: Any% NMG

games.description: Old school RPG from 1999, people might recognise the name from Heroes of Might and Magic which is a spin-off series. Run uses save/reload for RNG checks fairly often (Shops, NPCs, stealing) and for pathing through some of the dungeons.
games.name: Might and Magic 7: For Blood and Honor

categories.description: The category beats the game in the fastest time by using the glitched "Spacetime Beam", which allows funky things such as warping Samus and exploding the planet. This is an action-packed run, featuring multiple tricks and glitches in a mere span of 20 minutes, making an exciting yet hilarious watch.
categories.name: GT Code Space Time

games.description:
The category beats the game in the fastest time by using the glitched "Spacetime Beam", which allows funky things such as warping Samus and exploding the planet. This is an action-packed run, featuring multiple tricks and glitches in a mere span of 20 minutes, making an exciting yet hilarious watch.
In the Space time category, the actual machine is unstable, so to stabilize it, a Space time ROM is used.
This is also permitted under the Speedrun.com rules.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: From the start of the game, after activating the debug code in the GT section, to blowing up all the bosses at Zebes.
categories.name: GT  Code Classic

games.description:
This is the third installment in the 2D Metroid series.
From the start of the game, after activating the debug code in the GT section, to blowing up all the bosses at Zebes.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: This run features both the Swamp fishing hole and the Ocean fishing hole and catches all 24 fish. This is the full experience. We can show off the full set of unique designs the developers created for some of these fish.
categories.name: All Fish

categories.description: This run showcases catching the 12 fish in the Swamp fishing hole. This is the smaller of the two fishing holes which tends to make it the faster of the two. We catch some memorable fish such as the cucco fish and Lord Chapu Chapu, who has a stunning resemblance to an Ocarina of time dungeon.
categories.name: Swamp Fish

games.description: The 3DS remake added a little known side activity to Majora’s Mask: fishing! It unlocks nothing and can be completely ignored when 100%ing the game. But the 24 unique fish you are able to catch across two fishing holes make for some neat puzzles to solve, so I made a speedrun out of it! The fish spawn randomly, so you need to adjust your route on the fly.  We can save Termina in another cycle. We’re going fishin’!

It's a cult classic among many Playstation speedrunners.

categories.description: Any% finishes the main 120 levels and 6 bosses. games.description: Ghostland Yard is a 2D precision platformer with tons of challenge and a high skill ceiling.
